name: Jesse
summary: A man of Bethlehem, the grandson of Ruth and Boaz, and the father of eight sons. The LORD chose his youngest, David, to be king.

key_moments.title: His Sons Pass Before Samuel
key_moments.description: Samuel came to Bethlehem and had Jesse bring his sons before him, but the LORD chose none of the seven. Jesse sent for the youngest, David, who was keeping the sheep, and Samuel anointed him.

key_moments.title: Sending David to Saul
key_moments.description: King Saul sent word to Jesse asking for his son David. Jesse sent David with a donkey loaded with bread, a bottle of wine and a young goat.

key_moments.title: Sends David with Food for His Brothers
key_moments.description: Jesse was an old man, and his three eldest sons had gone to fight with Saul. He sent David with grain and loaves for his brothers and cheeses for their captain.
